steps.caption: Open Companies under Records in the sidebar.
This is every company you can see, A to Z. 'Show archived' brings back hidden ones.
Search first: someone may already have added this company.
Only 'Sahyadri Arc Realty' matches — a different company, so ours is new.
Display name: the name people use day to day.
Legal name only if you know it — e.g. from an invoice or MCA record.
More details holds website, CIN, GSTIN, sector, HQ country, headcount and GCC flag.
Fill only what you know. Here: the sector. Everything blank stays 'unknown'.
Classification controls who may see the record; the default is corporate confidential.
The company page opens. Its badges show classification and how fresh the facts are.
Identity shows the facts you gave; the rest say unknown — nothing is guessed.
Below: people, signals, locations and group structure — each folds open when you add to it.
